title: In Vitro 3D Multicellular Culture Model of Ovarian High-Grade Serous Carcinoma
author: Wennerberg, Bulanova, et al.

steps.title: Prepare 4.5 mg/mL collagen gel
steps.instruction: Rehydrate type I collagen powder to a 4.5 mg/mL solution one week before use and store at 4 °C for up to 3–4 months.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 11 mL of 0.3 % acetic acid by mixing pure acetic acid with PBS.
Place 50 mg collagen powder (the whole product) in a 50 mL tube.
Add the 11 mL 0.3 % acetic acid solution, vortex vigorously, and vortex twice daily.
Incubate the tube in a rotating device in a cold room for 1 week.

steps.title: Coat surfaces with 100 µg/mL collagen
steps.instruction: Dilute the 4.5 mg/mL collagen to 100 µg/mL on ice and coat culture vessels on the day CAF cultures are established.

substeps.instruction: Mix 110 µL of 4.5 mg/mL collagen with 10 mL cold PBS in a tube; invert gently (collagen is viscous).
Add the 100 µg/mL solution to the desired surface (1 mL per well of a 6‑well plate, 2 mL per T25 flask, 5 mL per T75 flask).
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.
Collect the collagen solution back into the tube; store at 4 °C for reuse (mix equal parts with freshly prepared solution if needed).
Wash the coated surface with PBS and add culture medium immediately.

steps.title: Prepare 2.25 mg/mL collagen
steps.instruction: Dilute the 4.5 mg/mL collagen to 2.25 mg/mL and adjust pH to 7.5–8 immediately before use.

substeps.instruction: Mix equal volumes of 4.5 mg/mL collagen and 2× MEM on ice, pipetting slowly.
Adjust pH to 7.5–8 with 1 M NaOH, adding 1 µL increments (up to 5 µL per 300 µL collagen) and checking with pH paper after each addition.
Use the diluted collagen immediately.

steps.title: Thaw and seed mesothelial cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend thawed cryopreserved patient sample and initiate primary mesothelial cell culture.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL pre‑warmed M199+ medium and transfer to a T25 flask.
Incubate at 37 °C, changing medium every 2–3 days, until cells reach ~90 % confluence.

steps.title: First passage of mesothelial cells
steps.instruction: Detach, count, and reseed mesothelial cells after the initial expansion.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells with 1 mL pre‑warmed PBS.
Add 0.5 mL pre‑warmed trypsin; incubate 5–10 min at 37 °C until detachment.
Add 1 mL pre‑warmed M199+ medium, resuspend, and take a 10 µL aliquot for counting.
Seed 1.5 × 10⁵ cells in a T25 flask or 3 × 10⁵ cells in a T75 flask.
Incubate, changing medium every 2–3 days, until ~90 % confluence is reached.

steps.title: Second passage and experimental seeding
steps.instruction: Expand cells again and seed a defined number for downstream assays.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 1–2 mL pre‑warmed PBS.
Add 0.5 mL trypsin per T25 (or 1.5 mL per T75); incubate 5–10 min at 37 °C.
Add 1 mL (T25) or 1.5 mL (T75) M199+ medium, resuspend, and take a 10 µL aliquot for counting.
Seed 1.5 × 10⁴ cells per well in 4 wells of an 8‑well chamber slide.
Incubate to confluence, changing medium every 2–3 days; use these cells for immunofluorescence characterization if desired.

steps.title: Cryopreserve remaining mesothelial cells
steps.instruction: Freeze surplus cells for long‑term storage.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the passage steps with the remaining cells.
Centrifuge cell suspensions at 300 × g for 5 min and aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL CryoStor cell cryopreservation medium (up to 4.5 × 10⁵ cells per cryovial).
Place cryovials in a CoolCell freezing container and store at –80 °C briefly, then transfer to liquid nitrogen for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Pause point – cell stocks ready
steps.instruction: All stromal cell types required for the multicellular model are now prepared and can be stored until needed.

steps.title: Wash MC domes before fixation
steps.instruction: Rinse the 3‑D domes in the 6‑well plate with pre‑warmed PBS and discard any adipocyte gels.

steps.title: Fix MC domes
steps.instruction: Fix domes with 4 % paraformaldehyde for 30 min at 20–25 °C in a fume hood; do not use cold PFA.

steps.title: Wash and store fixed domes
steps.instruction: Perform three 10‑min PBS washes at 20–25 °C on a low‑speed shaker, then store domes in PBS at 4 °C for 12–18 h (add 0.1 % sodium azide for storage >1 week).

steps.title: Permeabilize domes
steps.instruction: Transfer domes to a 48‑well plate containing 0.5 % Triton X‑100 in PBS and incubate 1 h at 20–25 °C on a low‑speed shaker.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 % Triton X‑100 in PBS to each well of a 48‑well plate.
Gently scrape each dome from the 6‑well plate with a cell lifter and place one dome per well using a small plastic spatula.
After incubation, carefully remove the permeabilization solution by tilting the plate.

steps.title: Block nonspecific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate domes in staining buffer for 7 h at 20–25 °C on a low‑speed shaker, then remove buffer.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate domes with primary antibody(s) diluted in staining buffer at 4 °C for 12–18 h.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash domes 3–4 times with 500 µL PBS per well, 30 min each at 20–25 °C on a low‑speed shaker (total 3–4 h).

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate domes with secondary antibody(s) diluted in staining buffer for 3 h at 20–25 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash domes 1–2 times with 500 µL PBS per well, 30 min each at 20–25 °C on a low‑speed shaker (total 1–2 h).

steps.title: Store domes before mounting
steps.instruction: Keep domes in PBS at 4 °C for 12–18 h prior to mounting.

steps.title: Mount domes for imaging
steps.instruction: Transfer each dome to a microscope slide, dry excess solution, add Prolong Gold Antifade with DAPI, place a coverslip, and cure 24 h at 20–25 °C in the dark without pressing the coverslip.

substeps.instruction: Using a small spatula, move a dome from the 48‑well plate to a microscope slide; gently dry surrounding liquid with lens‑cleaning paper, avoiding contact with the dome.
Add a droplet of Prolong Gold Antifade Mountant with DAPI on top of the dome.
Place a coverslip gently; let it settle by gravity.
Incubate the slide for 24 h at 20–25 °C in the dark before imaging.
